answer: The bridge register is checked at draw time, lagoon lists the eligible set, and tundra seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 52 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 52 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker burns for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 33 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
